f80671.title: AREA 2 — Session & CSRF test matrix (raw results)
f80671.content:
# AREA 2 — Session Management & CSRF — results

Target: http://172.17.112.1:8001 (HTTP, PHP 8.3)

## POSITIVE (defenses HELD)
- Session fixation: `session_regenerate_id(true)` on login. Pre-login PHPSESSID `hqt66u96...` -> post-login `21j6e9tt...` (rotated). Attacker-supplied id `attackerfixedsessionid123456` -> server issued `rahnv9lp...`; attacker id did NOT authenticate (302). DEFEATED.
- Logout: server-side destroy. Old PHPSESSID replay after logout -> /admin 302, /admin/news 302, POST /action/tatib 401. Session gone. HELD.
- CSRF token rotates on login: pre `9e6766...` vs post `8671a0...`; old pre-auth token rejected post-login (419). Pre-auth CSRF fixation DEFEATED.
- CSRF coverage: ALL state-changing endpoints return 419 without token: /action/login, /action/logout, /action/notifikasi, /action/upload, /action/pelanggaran (delete/confirm/save), /action/news (store/delete), /action/tatib (store/delete). HELD.
- CSRF cross-session replay: dosen token in admin session -> 419; admin token in dosen session -> 419. HELD.
- CSRF empty token (present but "") -> 419. Absent -> 419. HELD.
- No GET state-changing actions; GET /action/logout -> 405, GET /action/news -> 405. HELD.
- Authz after session events: unauth GET on /admin,/admin/*,/pelanggaran,/pelanggaran/dosen,/pelaporan,/notifikasi -> 302 /login. Wrong-role -> redirect. HELD.
- Session id entropy: 26 chars, base36 charset, PHP default CSPRNG. Adequate.
- storage/, storage/keys/app_token.key, /.env -> 403.

## WEAKNESSES FOUND
1. **Secure flag NOT set on PHPSESSID unless $_SERVER['HTTPS'] is literally set.** `session_set_cookie_params(['secure' => (!empty($_SERVER['HTTPS']) && $_SERVER['HTTPS'] !== 'off')])` (token_helper.php:13). Emitted cookie: `Set-Cookie: PHPSESSID=...; path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax` — no Secure.
   - INCONSISTENCY: seo_helper.php:219-222 treats `X-Forwarded-Proto: https` (and SERVER_PORT 443) as HTTPS for HSTS; token_helper does NOT. Demonstrated: `curl -H "X-Forwarded-Proto: https" -H "Host: example.com" /login` -> response has `Strict-Transport-Security` but PHPSESSID still WITHOUT `Secure`. Behind a TLS-terminating proxy this yields a session cookie transmissible over cleartext -> hijack risk.
2. **No absolute session lifetime.** `app_session_touch_or_expire(1800)` only enforces 30-min IDLE (refreshed on every request). No absolute cap. Stolen cookie valid indefinitely with periodic activity.
3. **Unlimited concurrent sessions; no invalidation.** Same account logged in twice -> both sessions 200 simultaneously (mahasiswa SID1 408jn9og.. & SID2 9m3rov..; dosen iqpeoc.. & qah2oh..). New login does not invalidate prior sessions. No session list/revoke.
4. CSRF token is session-global (not per-action / not single-use) — documented as accepted (multiple tabs). Low/info.

## NEGATIVE (token binding)
Capability tokens (id/file/route) are bound to hash(session_id) + exp, but every consumer endpoint also checks $_SESSION['username'] server-side, so "token survives logout" is not independently exploitable. Negative result.

3dcdb5.title: AREA 2 — FINAL summary + held-defense matrix
3dcdb5.content:
# AREA 2 — Session Management & CSRF — FINAL

## Filed
- **vuln-0001 MEDIUM (5.9, CWE-614)** — PHPSESSID not marked `Secure` when HTTPS signaled via `X-Forwarded-Proto`/`SERVER_PORT` instead of `$_SERVER['HTTPS']`. App emits HSTS (treats as HTTPS) yet cookie lacks Secure -> cleartext-carryable session cookie behind a TLS proxy. Evidence: `curl -H "X-Forwarded-Proto: https" -H "Host: dimspersonal.my.id" /login` -> HSTS present, `Set-Cookie: PHPSESSID=...; path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax` (no Secure). Fix: token_helper.php:13-17 secure check parity with seo_helper.php:219-222.
- **vuln-0002 LOW (3.7, CWE-613)** — no absolute session lifetime (only 30-min idle, refreshed every request) + unlimited concurrent sessions, new login does not invalidate old. Evidence: two simultaneous 200 sessions for same mahasiswa/dosen account.

## Defenses that HELD (negative results, README matrix)
| Test | Payload / action | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Session fixation (login rotation) | plant `PHPSESSID=attackerfixedsessionid123456`, login | ID rotated to new value; attacker id 302. DEFENDED |
| Session fixation (pre-auth CSRF) | reuse pre-login CSRF token post-login | 419; token rotated on login. DEFENDED |
| Logout server-side destroy | replay old PHPSESSID after POST /action/logout | /admin 302, POST action 401. DEFENDED |
| CSRF coverage — login | POST /action/login, no token | 419 |
| CSRF coverage — logout | POST /action/logout, no token | 419 |
| CSRF coverage — notifikasi | POST /action/notifikasi, no token | 419 |
| CSRF coverage — upload | POST /action/upload, no token | 419 |
| CSRF coverage — pelanggaran delete/confirm/save | POST /action/pelanggaran, no token | 419 |
| CSRF coverage — news store/delete | POST /action/news, no token | 419 |
| CSRF coverage — tatib store/delete | POST /action/tatib, no token | 419 |
| CSRF cross-session replay | session A token used in session B | 419 both directions |
| CSRF empty/absent token | `csrf_token=` / omitted | 419 |
| CSRF JSON body | send csrf in JSON | validated (419 on wrong, passes on right) |
| GET state-changing | GET /action/logout, /action/news | 405 (methods enforced) |
| Authz after session events | unauth GET /admin,/admin/*,/pelanggaran,/pelaporan,/notifikasi | 302 /login (server-side) |
| Role enforcement | mahasiswa/dosen -> /admin | redirected to own dashboard |
| Session id entropy | 12 samples | 26 chars, base36, PHP CSPRNG. Adequate |
| Sensitive path exposure | /storage/, /storage/keys/app_token.key, /.env | 403 |
| Token-survives-logout | capability token binding = hash(session_id) only | Not independently exploitable: every consumer also checks $_SESSION['username'] |

Scope covered. No SQLi/password-byte re-testing (AREA 1).
